content: You will be given an essay and asked about to annotate a specified part from it. Choose the argumentative role of the given sentence from list 1.opp (opponent), 2.pro (proponent). Choose only one label.

School uniforms should not be worn in our schools. They do offer the benefit that the competition over brand-name clothes and the discrimination of the socially weak are prevented. Nevertheless hardly anyone wishes to dress themselves or their children in a standard uniform. Plus such uniforms also stand for ideological conformity and for the suppression of individual self-development.
What is the argumentative role of "Plus such uniforms also stand for ideological conformity and for the suppression of individual self-development." from the given essay? choose from 1. opp 2. pro
